title: Polynomial time has polynomial-size circuits
statement: Every binary language decidable in polynomial time has a family of Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two that decides it, with constants $a,k \in \mathbb{N}$ such that the circuit for inputs of length $n$ has size at most $a(n+1)^k$.
